headline: Celestica Shares Surge 10% on Earnings Beat and Strong AI Outlook
summary: Celestica's stock jumped 10% following an earnings beat driven by surging artificial intelligence demand that also boosted its 2027 outlook.
why: Hardware manufacturers and electronic manufacturing services providers benefit significantly from the infrastructure buildout required by data centers running heavy AI workloads.

impacts.name: Celestica
impacts.why: Stronger earnings and raised guidance directly improve the company's fundamental valuation.

why_moved: An earnings beat combined with an upgraded forward outlook for AI-related demand provides concrete fundamental validation to investors bidding up tech supply-chain stocks.
